Order of Ouissam Alaouite.subject: Computer & IT
Order of Ouissam Alaouite.question: The _____ was Moroccan royal decoration.
Order of Ouissam Alaouite.fact: The Order of Ouissam Alaouite (Arabic: الوسام العلوي الشريف) or the Sharifian Order of Al-Alaoui is a military decoration of Morocco which is bestowed by the King of Morocco upon those civilians and military officers who have displayed heroism in combat or have contributed meritorious service to the Moroccan state. The Order of Ouissam Alaouite is similar to the Legion of Merit, awarded by the United States military.
